question: Is the documentOutput to outputLevel path present and physically effective in the current HEAD build?
head: 0b907ee0

artifact.note: Pre-existing workspace build, one minute before the HEAD commit timestamp. Not a fresh production rebuild.

runs.name: production graph unit-level physical proof
runs.method: Inject the bundled AudioGraphRouter into a page; drive a 1 kHz oscillator through it; sample the analyser RMS.
runs.assertions: gain in [0, 0.3, 0.7, 1, 2] gives rms approximately 0.1 * gain / sqrt(2); mute drives rms to zero; unmute restores it; legacy Boost and bypass release cleanly.
runs.note: The Chrome case is skipped by default and only runs when SPECTRA_CHROME_INTEGRATION=1.

runs.name: built-extension document-output fixture round
runs.method: Load the built extension into real Chrome; drive the Action Popup volume slider on an audio/video-separated fixture page; sample the product graph analyser in the offscreen target via CDP.
runs.skippedCase: controls a public separated live output with the product graph oracle
runs.note: Both release paths (audio-reset and restore-page-settings) pass. RMS is monotonic and proportional to the requested level.

notEvidenceFor: That nativeAudioAbsent resolves true on douyin.com, live.douyin.com or huya.com
That Capture is admitted on any real live room
That a viewer hears a change on a real broadcast
That the site's own volume UI follows the extension
That explicit-target and implicit-target gestures behave identically on a real site
That stale-media-source and the video-to-live selection handoff no longer reproduce on a real site

confirmed: The current HEAD build owns a separate document-output level through the admitted Capture graph
The product output signal scales with the requested 0..200 level on a fixture page
A real-site smoke case already exists and is gated by SPECTRA_DOCUMENT_OUTPUT_LIVE_URL
notConfirmed: The two guarded symptoms in 09 rows 1 and 2
